thread:
raj: Heads-up — ran a 48h synthetic long-span workload against kvcache on prod-like config and saw steady memory growth, looks like ~560MB leak per billion tokens after ~2B tokens :thinking_face:

anna: Yikes. Which workload? seq lengths, batching, and quantization?

raj: config: `--workload longspan --seq-dist heavy-tail --batcher continuous --quant q4_0`

raj: command:```bash
./kvcache_bench --profile longspan --duration 48h --max-tokens 3_000_000_000 \
  --batcher continuous --kv-size 64GB --pin-on-gpu
```

bench-bot: CI run uploaded: https://bench/results/2143201123 (artifact: heap-snapshots.tar.gz) :white_check_mark:

sasha: grabbed the heap diffs and did a quick compare — fragmentation spike around GC cycles 730-760, retained extents increase. flamegraph: https://perf/fg/2143201123 (large) :eyes:

kevin: hypothesis: KV slot reuse path isn't clearing stale slab metadata when a large top-k prefix gets evicted under long-context churn. Might be refcount off-by-one on reuse.

maria: noted a regression window — bisect points to commit `c3f9a2e` that touched `kv_slot_allocator.cc` (allocator -> reuse path) around last week.

anna: can you paste the small repro that hits it quickly? long 48h is heavy to iterate.

raj: minimal repro (fast mode) that reproduces mem-drift in ~30m:```bash
./kvcache_bench --profile longspan --duration 30m --token-rate 200k --seed 42 \
  --batcher continuous --kv-size 8GB --enable-fast-evict
```

raj: sample tail logs:```text
[2026-03-17T03:12:09Z] kv: evict range id=1205 size=2.1MB
[2026-03-17T03:12:09Z] kv: reuse slot id=987 mark=reused
[2026-03-17T03:12:09Z] kv: frag_monitor: retained_extents=1219 -> 1246
[2026-03-17T03:12:10Z] mem: rss=6.2GB -> 6.6GB
```

kevin: OK will add an assert around slot refcount and run local fuzz that toggles `enable-fast-evict`. If it's the reuse path we should see a mismatch.

maria: I'll trigger the bisect build + bench harness on infra. If it reproduces we can create a minimal unit test and revert `c3f9a2e` if needed.

sasha: also noticed allocator logs show `page_free` not always called when `reuse` path runs in the trace. attaching small grep:```text
grep "reuse slot" -n profile.log | head
124: reuse slot id=987
125: reuse slot id=987 state=dirty
126: reuse slot id=987 reuse_path=fast
130: eviction complete id=1205
132: page_free called=0
```

raj: tl;dr: reproducible with short fast-run, likely reuse/allocator bug, assigning kevin + maria to own the next steps. Can we have a perf/regress test added to the longspan suite?

anna: +1. Test checklist: reproduce in CI (fast mode), add heap-snapshot diff assertion, add refcount assert in debug builds, and a nightly longspan sweep.

kevin: I'll push a PR with extra assertions and the repro harness tonight.

bench-bot: scheduled: nightly-longspan-fast at 03:00 UTC starting 2026-03-18 — job id 2143201123-ntl

maria: adding ticket INF-2143 with links to artifacts + bisect result.

raj: thanks all. keep updates here. :thumbsup:
